specification.name: retail_clothing_regression
specification.scenario: Fictional independent retail clothing replenishment decisions using only information available before the next delivery; predict a continuous inventory-pressure score.
assumptions: Independent rows, no repeated store/item histories or temporal forecasting.
Inputs are sampled independently; business relationships are illustrative, not calibrated.
Higher inventory-pressure scores mean greater illustrative shortage pressure; negative scores are allowed. This is not demand units or a probability.
Inputs exist before the outcome; no IDs, future sales, or post-outcome indicators are predictors.
No size, style, seasonality, correlated demand, spoilage, or item/store histories are simulated; clothing labels supply context, not domain validation.

features.name: inventory_coverage
features.description: Clothing inventory coverage at decision time, in days

features.name: planned_discount_intensity
features.description: Planned clothing discount intensity, 0 to 1, known before replenishment

features.name: recent_clothing_demand_index
features.description: Clothing demand index from earlier observations only, in illustrative units
